scope: ALL the listed trained blocks of the export's model (TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat or Llama-3-8B) as ONE bound run at the export's T (one transcript, hidden internal boundaries); embedding, final norm, LM head and token selection are NOT covered (D13); CPU unless the run line says gpu; NO privacy acceptance at this shape (D22 covers only the toy); float fidelity is the calibration lane's measurement
statement_written_by: stack-verify, after its fresh-process verification of the run directory, from its own data and the hashes of the bytes it verified

prover_reported.what: self-reports of the prover (privacy review P-7): a CPU proof and a GPU proof have the same form, so no verifier can check these fields

run_construction: D55 commit, fork, join (a registered opt-in run profile, ruling D60): every internal boundary committed before any block challenge, each block proved on its own fork of that transcript, one joined opening phase; the frames are d55-head.bin, d55-fork-NNN.bin and d55-tail.bin
